name: print-social-bioverse-serum-on-beach-chair-summer-ad
title: Bioverse serum bottle on a striped beach chair under a parasol with a red script 'Perfect for sunny days'
whatItIs: A composite ad with a white serum dropper bottle sitting upright on a blue-and-white striped deckchair under a matching parasol on a sunny beach, a red script 'Perfect for sunny days' with small benefit words, a beach ball, pink flowers and an 'Order now' sticker.
whatItMeans: Playful and seasonal; putting the bottle in a human setting makes it feel like it's on holiday too.
techniques: Place the product as if it were a person in a scene.
Match the prop stripes to the product's colours.
Weave small benefit words into a script headline.

vocabulary.definition: Compositing a product into a staged photo scene.
Treating an object as if it were a person.
